backgroundTheme.name: chapter_3_cryo_background_theme
wallRules: sealed wall segment for hidden doors

mistEffects.CryoSmokeVent: active chapter 3 cold mist uses top-down smoke sprite animation loops for local freezer vents, pod leaks and damaged coolant pipe steam
mistEffects.CryoFloorFogLayer: Noiselong.png floor fog asset is imported but not actively spawned in rooms after v0.3.6g, to avoid static overlay-like cold air

backgroundTheme.collisionPolicy: Background decals and mist effects are visual only. Existing authored blockers and interactables keep their original collision.
v036cRefinements: Inherited base room wall and door art is hidden for chapter 3 rooms; CryoRoomOverlay draws the full cold-storage wall and door visuals.
Only connected directions draw passable frosted cryo door frames.
Unconnected directions draw no door-like structures; the continuous cryo wall remains uninterrupted.
Cryo mist uses low-alpha soft fog and pale cold-white particles instead of bright cyan energy lines.
v036eRefinements: Imported Noiselong.png for drifting floor fog and smoke9/smoke10 bright/middle gray frames for local freezer steam.
Deprecated the old GPUParticles2D cirle_particle-based cryo mist in CryoRoomOverlay.
CryoSmokeVent handles pod, vent and pipe leak puffs with imported smoke animation frames.
Large side-wall freezer units were moved away from the center of side walls to reduce false door silhouettes.
v036fRefinements: CryoRoomOverlay now uses LandOfPixels atlas sprites for cold metal floor panels and cold-storage wall panels instead of relying on dark rectangles.
Sci-Fi Facility atlas sprites are used for refrigeration vents, coolant pipe walls and temperature control panels.
Top, bottom, left and right walls use different cryogenic structures: equipment vents, maintenance pipes, vertical coolant pipes and freezer locker walls.
Hidden door directions are filled with sealed insulated wall, storage locker, pipe or vent modules instead of door-like frames.
Floor visuals now combine cold metal grid panels, low-temperature boundary markings, coolant channels, frost edge and condensation layers.
Yellow-black warning stripes and large ice sticker shapes are not part of the chapter 3 main background language.
v036gRefinements: All CryoRoomOverlay wall, floor, fog, vent, label and equipment visuals are pinned to the background draw layer so they cannot cover players, enemies, bosses or bullets.
Active cold air in rooms now uses CryoSmokeVent imported top-down smoke animation frames only; static floor fog is kept as an imported asset but is not spawned by CryoRoomOverlay.
Mist and wall decorations remain visual only and do not add collision, damage areas, room objectives or pathing changes.
Large irregular sealed-wall frost patches were replaced with thin wall frost seams so sealed directions read as walls, not floating ice blocks or fake doors.

notes: Third chapter playable rooms use reusable room scenes plus CryoRoomOverlay for chapter_3_cryo_background_theme visuals, cold storage wall coverage, cryogenic floor decals and local cryo mist effects. Imported tilesets remain the preferred art source for future final room art.
